basic_details.job_title: Amrita Research Trainee Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Amritapuri Campus has one vacancy for the post of Research Trainee at Kollam, Keralam, and a postgraduate qualification is mandatory. Applications are made online through the Apply Online link on the job page, and the last date to apply is 14 November 2026.

qualification.details: The notice states the qualification as "PG Mandatory". It does not name the subject or degree. Candidates should check the official job page for any discipline-specific eligibility.

how_to_apply: Open the Research Trainee at Amritapuri job page on the Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham website.
Use the Apply Online (Apply Now) link on that page to submit the application.
The notice does not list the documents to be submitted.

content_sections.heading: About Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Amritapuri Campus
content_sections.text: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham runs the Amritapuri Campus, which is listed on the notice at Kollam, Keralam. The post is advertised under the Jobs section of the Amrita website as "Research Trainee at Amritapuri". The posting is in the Non-Teaching job category.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice states the qualification as "PG Mandatory". It does not name the subject or degree. Candidates should check the official job page for any discipline-specific eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Amrita Research Trainee Job Description
content_sections.text: Assist the Team lead in various departmental projects.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Amrita Research Trainee
content_sections.text: Open the Research Trainee at Amritapuri job page on the Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham website. Use the Apply Online (Apply Now) link on that page to submit the application. Apply on or before 14 November 2026. For details, write to [email protected] . The notice does not list the documents to be submitted.
